dialogues.speaker: Dr. Edith
dialogues.text: Ah, sorry! I forgot to introduce myself.

dialogues.speaker: Dr. Edith
dialogues.text: Just call me Edith. I'm a historian and folklore researcher, lately I've been looking for material for my new book.

dialogues.speaker: Dr. Edith
dialogues.text: You might have met the scholar with the strange hilichurl obsession? That's my older sister, Ella Musk.
